title: Dunhuang: 492 Caves by Day or Desert Stars by Night? | China Travel Expert
description:
Dunhuang gives you two completely different days in one Silk Road town — so which do you book first?

By day: the Mogao Grottoes, about 492 painted caves carved over a thousand years. The peak-season ticket is ¥238 (~$34) and includes a shuttle, two digital films and a guided tour of eight caves — and daily entries are capped. By night: climb the Mingsha sand dunes to Crescent Lake (¥110, ~$15) and stay for a desert sky full of stars — no extra ticket required.

🧭 Expert Tip: Reserve Mogao Grottoes several days ahead — daily tickets are limited and sell out in peak season; do the dunes at sunset-into-night to beat the heat.

敦煌的一天有两种：白天莫高窟（约492个洞窟，旺季¥238），晚上爬鸣沙山看月牙泉、数星星（¥110，夜游不另收费）。你先去哪个？
